description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the MediaPipeline component in a media playback system, including factory creation, media pipeline states, and client interactions. It contains class declarations, enums, and method signatures but no implementation details.

classes.name: MediaPipeline
classes.description: Represents a media playback pipeline, managing media sources, playback states, and communication with media hardware or processes.

classes.name: MediaPipeline::State
classes.description: Enumeration of possible states of the MediaPipeline, such as IDLE, BUFFERING, PLAYING, SEEKING, FAILURE, and END_OF_STREAM.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type with given MIME type and URL into the pipeline.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the pipeline by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all media sources are attached.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the current playback position.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video display window position and size.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates whether media data is available.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline of a change in playback state.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline of a change in playback position.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline of network state changes.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline that media data is needed.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline of QoS (Quality of Service) information.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline of buffer underflow events.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a media frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the media volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current media volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the media.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves the mute state.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies the pipeline of application state changes.
